description: Delete a shared group together with its environments and their secrets, discarding the ciphertext. Irreversible. Every application environment that composed this group loses those names — check list_env_groups (or use uncompose_group) before deciding the group is unused. Confirm intent before calling. Returns { ok, group }.

group.description: Shared-group slug or id, as returned by list_groups (e.g. "shared-datastores").

org.description: Organization slug or id. Omit it when the credential can reach exactly one org — that org is used automatically. With several, the error names every slug you may pass; list them yourself with list_orgs.

name: delete_group
